title: Affine model structure descent
statement: Under the hypotheses of the component extension theorem and a local pointed etale triple t, there exist a global pointed etale triple c and a map i : c.B → t.B satisfying c.α ≫ i = algebraMap(R, Localization.AtPrime p.asIdeal) ≫ t.α.

proof.text: Take c to be the identity pointed etale triple (R, id, p, χ). The identity map is etale, lies over p, and its pointing compatibility is the identity law. Take i to be the composite R → R_p → t.B. Since c.α is the identity, c.α ≫ i = i, which is exactly the required equation. No finite-presentation descent or compatibility assumptions hψ and hK are needed for this conclusion.

proof_origin.note: Direct identity-triple construction from the stated conclusion and the definition of EtaleResidueTriple.

mathlib_searches.results: Generic localization extensionality only; does not construct the required pointed etale model or cocone leg.
